integrity: All proofs and computations have been self-reviewed, without independent mathematical audit; unknown unindexed equivalences remain a residual originality risk. First-public date is based on verifiable original arXiv version, not later revisions or journal dates.
scientific_limitations: Finite conservative continuous-time Markov generators and completed theta steps only; arbitrary stationary-class structure is allowed. The sharp timestep root is implicit, not uniformly elementary. Nonlinear positivity, internal stages, higher-order methods, infinite chains and nonconservative systems are excluded.
title: A one-interval positivity theorem for every finite Markov theta step
